Văn Lang.name: Hùng kings
Văn Lang.note: Legendary line of eighteen kings in Vietnamese tradition.
Văn Lang.note_zh: 越南传说中的十八代雄王。

Âu Lạc.name: An Dương Vương (Thục Phán)
Âu Lạc.note: Built the citadel of Cổ Loa.

Nanyue.name: Zhao Jiande
Nanyue.note: Han Emperor Wu conquered Nanyue in 111 BCE.
Nanyue.note_zh: 公元前111年汉武帝灭南越。

people.name: Trưng Trắc and Trưng Nhị
people.known_for: Two sisters who led a rising against Han rule in Jiaozhi in 40 CE and ruled for three years.
people.known_for_zh: 姐妹二人于公元40年在交趾起兵反抗东汉统治，自立为王三年，后被马援镇压。

Funan.name: Fan Shiman
Funan.note: Built Funan into a sea power.

Funan.name: Fan Xun
Funan.note: Received the Wu envoys Kang Tai and Zhu Ying.
Funan.note_zh: 接待东吴使者康泰、朱应。

Funan.name: Kaundinya II
Funan.note: An Indian Brahmin who reformed Funan on Indian lines.
Funan.note_zh: 印度婆罗门，按印度制度改革扶南。

Champa.name: Bhadravarman I
Champa.name_zh: 拔陀罗跋摩一世（范胡达）
Champa.note: Founded the shrine at Mỹ Sơn.

people.name: Shi Xie
people.known_for: Governor of Jiaozhi for forty years who kept the region at peace and spread Chinese learning.
people.known_for_zh: 东汉末年交趾太守，治理交趾四十年，保境安民，传播儒学，越南史家尊为“士王”。

people.name: Lady Triệu
people.known_for: Young woman who led a rising against Eastern Wu rule in 248.
people.known_for_zh: 248年在九真郡起兵反抗东吴统治的女英雄，越南民族英雄之一。

people.name: Lý Bí
people.known_for: Drove out the Liang governor and founded the short-lived state of Vạn Xuân in 544.
people.known_for_zh: 起兵驱逐南梁刺史，544年称帝建立万春国，史称李南帝。

people.name: Phạm Tu
people.known_for: General of Lý Bí who defeated an attack from Lâm Ấp and died fighting the Liang army.
people.known_for_zh: 李贲麾下大将，曾击退林邑进犯，后在抵抗南梁军队时战死。

people.name: Gunavarman
people.known_for: Kashmiri monk who converted the king and court of Java to Buddhism before sailing on to China.
people.known_for_zh: 罽宾高僧，在阇婆国弘法使国王皈依佛教，后渡海到南朝宋译经。

Srivijaya Empire.name: Dapunta Hyang Sri Jayanasa
Srivijaya Empire.note: Known from the Kedukan Bukit inscription of 683.
Srivijaya Empire.note_zh: 见于683年的格杜坎武吉碑铭。

Srivijaya Empire.name: Sri Indravarman
Srivijaya Empire.note: Sent envoys to the Tang court.

Chen-La.name: Jayadevi
Chen-La.note: After her reign Chenla split into Land and Water Chenla.
Chen-La.note_zh: 其后真腊分裂为陆真腊和水真腊。

Mataram.name: Sanjaya
Mataram.note: Known from the Canggal inscription of 732.

Mataram.name: Samaratungga
Mataram.note: Under the Sailendras Borobudur was completed.
Mataram.note_zh: 夏连特拉王朝时期建成婆罗浮屠。

people.name: Mai Thúc Loan
people.known_for: Led a great rising against the Tang in Annam in 722 and called himself the Black Emperor.
people.known_for_zh: 722年在驩州起兵反抗唐朝安南都护府，自称“黑帝”，后被唐军镇压。

people.name: Phùng Hưng
people.known_for: Rebel leader who took the Tang seat of Annam and held it until his death in 791.
people.known_for_zh: 起兵攻占唐安南都护府治所宋平并据守至791年去世，被尊为“布盖大王”。

Khmer Empire.name: Jayavarman II
Khmer Empire.note_zh: 802年自立为“转轮王”，开创吴哥王朝。

Khmer Empire.name: Yasovarman I
Khmer Empire.note_zh: 在吴哥建立都城耶输陀罗补罗。

check.n_zh: 维基载1002年（或1010年）至1050年在位。

Khmer Empire.name: Jayavarman VII
Khmer Empire.note: Drove out the Cham and built Angkor Thom and the Bayon.
Khmer Empire.note_zh: 驱逐占婆军队，修建吴哥城与巴戎寺。

Kingdom of Pagan.name: Anawrahta
Kingdom of Pagan.note: Unified Burma and adopted Theravada Buddhism.
Kingdom of Pagan.note_zh: 统一缅甸，推崇上座部佛教。

Kingdom of Pagan.name: Kyansittha
Kingdom of Pagan.note: Completed the Shwezigon and built the Ananda Temple.
Kingdom of Pagan.note_zh: 建成瑞喜宫佛塔并修建阿难陀寺。

Đại Việt.name: Ngô Quyền
Đại Việt.note: Won independence at Bạch Đằng in 938.
Đại Việt.note_zh: 938年白藤江之战获胜，越南脱离中国独立。

Đại Việt.name: Đinh Tiên Hoàng (Đinh Bộ Lĩnh)
Đại Việt.note: Named the state Đại Cồ Việt.

Đại Việt.name: Lý Thái Tổ (Lý Công Uẩn)
Đại Việt.note: Moved the capital to Thăng Long (Hanoi) in 1010.

people.name: Ngô Quyền
people.known_for: Defeated the Southern Han fleet on the Bạch Đằng River in 938 and ended a thousand years of Chinese rule.
people.known_for_zh: 938年在白藤江大败南汉水军，结束中国对越南北部千年的统治，建立吴朝。

people.name: Vạn Hạnh
people.known_for: Zen master who advised the founding of the Lý dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 越南禅宗高僧，辅佐李公蕴建立李朝，对李朝崇佛之风影响很大。

people.name: Lý Công Uẩn
people.known_for: Founder of the Lý dynasty who moved the capital to Thăng Long, the later Hanoi.
people.known_for_zh: 李朝开国皇帝李太祖，1010年颁布《迁都诏》，迁都升龙即今河内。

works.title: Edict on the Transfer of the Capital

people.name: Lý Thường Kiệt
people.known_for: Lý general who attacked Song China in 1075 and held the Như Nguyệt line against the Song counterattack.
people.known_for_zh: 李朝名将，1075年北伐宋朝，次年在如月江防线击退宋军，相传作《南国山河》诗。

people.name: Lady Ỷ Lan
people.known_for: Consort of Lý Thánh Tông who ran the state while he was at war and later as regent.
people.known_for_zh: 李圣宗元妃，皇帝出征时主持朝政，后以太后身份辅佐李仁宗。

people.name: Lê Văn Thịnh
people.known_for: Top graduate of Vietnam's first civil service examination in 1075, later grand chancellor.
people.known_for_zh: 越南1075年首次科举考试的状元，后官至太师。

check.n: Birth year disputed: English Wikipedia gives 1038, other sources 1050.
check.n_zh: 生年有争议：英文维基百科作1038年，其他资料作1050年。

people.name: Tô Hiến Thành
people.known_for: Upright chancellor and general of the Lý court, remembered as a model official.
people.known_for_zh: 李朝太尉，为官清正，辅佐幼主，被后世视为忠臣典范。

people.name: Shin Arahan
people.known_for: Mon monk who won King Anawrahta to Theravada Buddhism and became primate of Pagan.
people.known_for_zh: 孟族高僧，劝导阿奴律陀王皈依上座部佛教，成为蒲甘王朝的僧王。

people.name: Airlangga
people.known_for: Javanese king who rebuilt the kingdom of East Java after its collapse and divided it between his sons.
people.known_for_zh: 东爪哇国王，在王国崩溃后重建卡胡里潘王国，晚年将国土分给两个儿子。

Đại Việt.name: Lý Chiêu Hoàng
Đại Việt.note: Last Lý ruler; she passed the throne to her husband Trần Cảnh.
Đại Việt.note_zh: 李朝末代君主，让位于丈夫陈煚。

Đại Việt.name: Trần Thái Tông
Đại Việt.note: Beat back the first Mongol invasion in 1258.

Đại Việt.name: Trần Nhân Tông
Đại Việt.note: Led the defence against the Yuan in 1285 and 1288.

Đại Việt.name: Trần Duệ Tông
Đại Việt.note: Killed in a campaign against Champa.

Đại Việt.name: Trần Thiếu Đế
Đại Việt.note: Deposed by his grandfather Hồ Quý Ly.

Sukhothai.name: Ram Khamhaeng
Sukhothai.note: Credited with creating the Thai script.

Sukhothai.name: Li Thai (Maha Thammaracha I)
Sukhothai.name_zh: 立泰（摩诃达摩罗阇一世）
Sukhothai.note: Buddhist scholar king, author of the Traiphum.
Sukhothai.note_zh: 崇佛学者国王，著有《三界论》。

Sukhothai.name: Maha Thammaracha II
Sukhothai.note: Became a vassal of Ayutthaya in 1378.

Singhasari.name: Ken Arok (Rajasa)
Singhasari.note_zh: 新柯沙里王朝的建立者。

Singhasari.name: Kertanegara
Singhasari.note: Insulted Kublai Khan's envoy and was killed by a rebel vassal.
Singhasari.note_zh: 曾黥面忽必烈使者，后死于属国叛乱。

Majapahit.name: Raden Wijaya (Kertarajasa)
Majapahit.note: Used the Yuan army against his rivals, then drove it out.
Majapahit.note_zh: 借元军打败对手后又将元军逐出爪哇，建立满者伯夷。

Majapahit.name: Hayam Wuruk (Rajasanagara)
Majapahit.note: Majapahit reached its height under him and Gajah Mada.
Majapahit.note_zh: 在其与加查·马达治下满者伯夷达到鼎盛。

people.name: Trần Hưng Đạo
people.known_for: Commander who defeated the Yuan invasions of 1285 and 1288, ending with the battle of Bạch Đằng.
people.known_for_zh: 陈朝统帅，指挥抗击1285年和1288年元军入侵，在白藤江之战中大败元军。

people.name: Trần Thủ Độ
people.known_for: Powerful minister who moved the throne from the Lý to the Trần family and organised resistance to the Mongols.
people.known_for_zh: 权臣，策划李朝传位于陈氏，建立陈朝，并主持抗击蒙古第一次入侵。

people.name: Trần Nhân Tông
people.known_for: Emperor who led the war against the Yuan, then became a monk and founded the Trúc Lâm school of Zen.
people.known_for_zh: 领导抗元战争的陈朝皇帝，退位后出家，创立越南竹林禅派。

people.name: Trần Quang Khải
people.known_for: Prince and general who retook the capital from the Yuan in 1285 and wrote poems on the victory.
people.known_for_zh: 陈朝亲王、将领，1285年收复京城，并写诗记述抗元胜利。

people.name: Lê Văn Hưu
people.known_for: Court historian who wrote the first official history of Vietnam in 1272.
people.known_for_zh: 陈朝史官，1272年编成越南第一部官修史书《大越史记》。

people.name: Mạc Đĩnh Chi
people.known_for: Top examination graduate famed for his wit as an envoy to the Yuan court.
people.known_for_zh: 陈朝状元，出使元朝时以机智应对闻名，被称为“两国状元”。

people.name: Chu Văn An
people.known_for: Confucian teacher who asked the king to behead seven corrupt officials, then retired to teach.
people.known_for_zh: 陈朝著名儒学教育家，曾上《七斩疏》请诛奸臣，未获采纳后辞官归隐讲学。

people.name: Ram Khamhaeng
people.known_for: King who expanded Sukhothai and is credited with the Thai script and the famous stone inscription.
people.known_for_zh: 素可泰国王，扩张国土，相传创制泰文并留下著名的兰甘亨碑铭。

people.name: Mangrai
people.known_for: Founder of the northern Thai kingdom of Lan Na and of its capital Chiang Mai in 1296.
people.known_for_zh: 兰纳王国的创建者，1296年修建清迈城作为都城。

people.name: Wareru
people.known_for: Founded the Mon kingdom of Hanthawaddy in Lower Burma after the fall of Pagan.
people.known_for_zh: 蒲甘衰落后在下缅甸建立孟族汉达瓦底王国，并编订《伐丽流法典》。

people.name: Gajah Mada
people.known_for: Chief minister of Majapahit who swore the Palapa oath to unite the archipelago.
people.known_for_zh: 满者伯夷宰相，立下“帕拉帕誓言”，立志统一群岛，使王国达到鼎盛。

people.name: Mpu Prapanca
people.known_for: Buddhist court poet whose Nagarakretagama of 1365 describes Majapahit under Hayam Wuruk.
people.known_for_zh: 满者伯夷宫廷诗人，1365年写成长诗《爪哇史颂》，记述哈奄·武禄时代的王国。

people.name: Mpu Tantular
people.known_for: Majapahit poet whose Sutasoma gave Indonesia its motto Bhinneka Tunggal Ika, unity in diversity.
people.known_for_zh: 满者伯夷诗人，其长诗《苏塔索玛》中的“殊途同归”成为印度尼西亚国家格言。

people.name: Fa Ngum
people.known_for: Founded the Lao kingdom of Lan Xang in 1353 with Khmer support and brought Theravada Buddhism.
people.known_for_zh: 1353年在高棉支持下建立澜沧王国，引入上座部佛教，被视为老挝的开国君主。

people.name: Ramathibodi I (U Thong)
people.name_zh: 拉玛铁菩提一世（乌通王）
people.known_for: Founded the kingdom of Ayutthaya in 1351 and issued its first law code.
people.known_for_zh: 1351年建立阿瑜陀耶王国，颁布最早的法典。

people.name: Chế Bồng Nga
people.known_for: Cham king who sacked Thăng Long several times before he was killed in 1390.
people.known_for_zh: 占婆国王，多次攻入大越京城升龙，1390年战死。

Malacca.name: Parameswara
Malacca.note: Founded Malacca and visited the Ming court in 1411.
Malacca.note_zh: 建立满剌加，1411年亲赴明朝朝贡。

Malacca.name: Mahmud Shah
Malacca.note: Lost Malacca to the Portuguese in 1511.

Ayutthaya.name: Trailokanat
Ayutthaya.note: Reorganised the government and the sakdina ranks.
Ayutthaya.note_zh: 改革行政制度，确立萨迪纳等级制。

Đại Việt.name: Hồ Hán Thương
Đại Việt.note: The Ming conquered Đại Việt in 1407 and ruled it until 1427.

Pegu.name: Razadarit
Pegu.note: Fought the Forty Years' War against Ava.
Pegu.note_zh: 与阿瓦王国进行“四十年战争”。

Pegu.name: Dhammazedi
Pegu.note: Reformed the Buddhist order with the Kalyani inscriptions.
Pegu.note_zh: 立迦尼耶碑铭，整顿僧团。

people.name: Hồ Quý Ly
people.known_for: Minister who seized the Trần throne in 1400 and pushed bold reforms such as paper money and land limits.
people.known_for_zh: 1400年篡夺陈朝建立胡朝，推行发行纸币、限田等激进改革，后被明军俘虏。

people.name: Lê Lợi
people.known_for: Led the Lam Sơn rising that drove out the Ming in 1427 and founded the Later Lê dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 领导蓝山起义，1427年驱逐明军，次年建立后黎朝，即黎太祖。

people.name: Nguyễn Trãi
people.known_for: Strategist of the Lam Sơn rising and great poet, who wrote the victory proclamation of 1428.
people.known_for_zh: 蓝山起义的谋士和大文豪，1428年写下《平吴大诰》，也是喃字诗歌的大家。

works.title: Great Proclamation upon the Pacification of the Wu

people.name: Lê Thánh Tông
people.known_for: Emperor whose reign was a golden age: he issued the Hồng Đức code and conquered Champa's capital in 1471.
people.known_for_zh: 后黎朝君主，颁布《洪德法典》，1471年攻破占城都城，开创“洪德盛世”。

people.name: Lương Thế Vinh
people.known_for: Top examination graduate and mathematician, author of an early Vietnamese arithmetic book.
people.known_for_zh: 后黎朝状元、数学家，编有越南早期的算术著作，民间称“状元梁”。

people.name: Tun Perak
people.known_for: Bendahara (chief minister) who served four sultans and made Malacca the leading power of the straits.
people.known_for_zh: 满剌加宰相，先后辅佐四位苏丹，使满剌加成为海峡地区最强大的国家。

people.name: Sunan Ampel
people.known_for: One of the Wali Songo, the nine saints who spread Islam in Java.
people.known_for_zh: 爪哇“九贤”之一，在泗水建立学校传播伊斯兰教，影响深远。

people.name: Sunan Giri
people.known_for: One of the Wali Songo, who ran a famous Islamic school at Giri near Gresik.
people.known_for_zh: 爪哇“九贤”之一，在锦石附近的吉里建立著名的伊斯兰学校。

people.name: Raden Patah
people.known_for: Founded the Sultanate of Demak, the first Muslim state on Java, which replaced Majapahit.
people.known_for_zh: 建立淡目苏丹国，这是爪哇第一个伊斯兰国家，取代了满者伯夷。

people.name: Shin Maha Thilawuntha
people.known_for: Burmese monk who wrote the earliest surviving national chronicle of Burma.
people.known_for_zh: 缅甸僧人、史家，著有现存最早的缅甸编年史《简明史》。

people.name: Shin Maha Rahtathara
people.known_for: Monk regarded as one of the greatest classical Burmese poets.
people.known_for_zh: 缅甸僧人，被视为缅甸古典诗歌最伟大的诗人之一。

Rattanakosin Kingdom.name_zh: 吞武里王朝与曼谷王朝

Ayutthaya.name: Maha Thammarachathirat
Ayutthaya.note: Ruled as a Burmese vassal after the fall of Ayutthaya in 1569.
Ayutthaya.note_zh: 1569年阿瑜陀耶陷落后作为缅甸藩属国王。

Ayutthaya.name: Ekkathat
Ayutthaya.note: Ayutthaya was destroyed by the Burmese in 1767.
Ayutthaya.note_zh: 1767年阿瑜陀耶被缅军攻陷焚毁。

Rattanakosin Kingdom.name: Thongduang (Phutthayotfa Chulalok)
Rattanakosin Kingdom.note: Founded Bangkok and the Chakri dynasty.
Rattanakosin Kingdom.note_zh: 建立曼谷城和却克里王朝。

Đại Việt.name: Trịnh Kiểm
Đại Việt.note: Real power behind the restored Lê emperors.
Đại Việt.note_zh: 以辅佐复辟的黎朝为名掌握实权。

Đại Việt.name: Trịnh Tùng
Đại Việt.note: Took Thăng Long from the Mạc in 1592.

Đại Việt.name: Trịnh Tráng
Đại Việt.note: Fought the Nguyễn lords of the south.

Đại Việt.name: Nguyễn Phúc Ánh
Đại Việt.note: Founded the Nguyễn dynasty and named the country Việt Nam.
Đại Việt.note_zh: 建立阮朝，定国号为越南。

Burmese kingdoms.name: Tabinshwehti
Burmese kingdoms.note: Reunited Burma under the Toungoo dynasty.
Burmese kingdoms.note_zh: 以东吁王朝重新统一缅甸。

Burmese kingdoms.name: Hsinbyushin
Burmese kingdoms.note: Destroyed Ayutthaya and fought off the Qing invasions.
Burmese kingdoms.note_zh: 攻灭阿瑜陀耶，并击退清军的进攻。

people.name: Tomé Pires
people.known_for: Portuguese apothecary whose Suma Oriental is the fullest early European account of Asian trade.
people.known_for_zh: 葡萄牙药剂师，所著《东方志》是欧洲人对亚洲贸易最早最详尽的记述之一。

people.name: Lapulapu
people.known_for: Chief of Mactan whose warriors killed Ferdinand Magellan in battle in 1521.
people.known_for_zh: 麦克坦岛首领，1521年率众击败西班牙人并杀死麦哲伦，被菲律宾视为民族英雄。

people.name: Miguel López de Legazpi
people.known_for: Spanish conquistador who began Spanish rule in the Philippines and founded Manila in 1571.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙殖民者，开启西班牙对菲律宾的统治，1571年建立马尼拉城。

people.name: Bayinnaung
people.known_for: Toungoo king who built the largest empire in Southeast Asian history, taking Ayutthaya in 1564 and 1569.
people.known_for_zh: 东吁王朝国王，建立东南亚历史上疆域最大的帝国，两度攻陷阿瑜陀耶。

people.name: Naresuan
people.known_for: King who freed Ayutthaya from Burma, famous for the elephant duel at Nong Sarai in 1593.
people.known_for_zh: 阿瑜陀耶国王，摆脱缅甸控制，1593年在象战中击杀缅甸王储，被尊为“纳黎萱大帝”。

people.name: Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm
people.known_for: Scholar and poet of the Mạc court, famous for his prophecies and moral verse.
people.known_for_zh: 莫朝学者、诗人，以诗文和预言闻名，被尊称为“状程”。

people.name: Phùng Khắc Khoan
people.known_for: Scholar and envoy to Ming China who brought back maize and new farming methods.
people.known_for_zh: 后黎朝学者、使臣，出使明朝时带回玉米种子等农作物。

people.name: Đào Duy Từ
people.known_for: Strategist of the Nguyễn lords who built the Đồng Hới walls against the Trịnh.
people.known_for_zh: 阮主的重要谋臣，主持修筑洞海垒等防线抵御郑主。

people.name: Alexandre de Rhodes
people.known_for: Jesuit missionary whose dictionary of 1651 fixed the Latin based Vietnamese script.
people.known_for_zh: 耶稣会传教士，1651年出版越葡拉词典，奠定越南拉丁字母文字国语字的基础。

people.name: Jan Pieterszoon Coen
people.known_for: Governor general of the Dutch East India Company who founded Batavia in 1619.
people.known_for_zh: 荷兰东印度公司总督，1619年建立巴达维亚（今雅加达），以残酷手段垄断香料贸易。

people.name: Sultan Agung
people.known_for: Ruler of Mataram who united most of Java and twice besieged Dutch Batavia.
people.known_for_zh: 马打兰苏丹国君主，统一爪哇大部分地区，两次围攻荷兰人的巴达维亚。

people.name: Iskandar Muda
people.known_for: Sultan under whom Aceh reached its height as a trading and military power.
people.known_for_zh: 亚齐苏丹，在位时亚齐达到鼎盛，控制苏门答腊北部和马来半岛的贸易。

people.name: Sultan Hasanuddin
people.known_for: Sultan of Gowa who fought the Dutch East India Company, called the Rooster of the East.
people.known_for_zh: 哥哇苏丹，顽强抵抗荷兰东印度公司，被称为“东方雄鸡”。

people.name: Georg Eberhard Rumphius
people.known_for: German naturalist in Dutch service who described the plants of the Moluccas.
people.known_for_zh: 在荷兰东印度公司任职的德国博物学家，系统记述了摩鹿加群岛的植物。

people.name: Constantine Phaulkon
people.known_for: Greek adventurer who became chief minister of King Narai and was executed in the revolution of 1688.
people.known_for_zh: 希腊冒险家，成为那莱王的首席大臣，1688年政变中被处死。

people.name: Kosa Pan
people.known_for: Siamese envoy who led King Narai's embassy to Louis XIV in 1686.
people.known_for_zh: 暹罗使节，1686年率那莱王使团出访法国路易十四宫廷。

people.name: Diego Silang
people.known_for: Ilocano leader of a revolt against Spanish rule during the British occupation of Manila.
people.known_for_zh: 伊洛卡诺人领袖，在英军占领马尼拉期间领导反抗西班牙统治的起义，后遇刺身亡。

people.name: Lê Quý Đôn
people.known_for: Encyclopedic scholar of the Lê court who wrote widely on history, geography and literature.
people.known_for_zh: 后黎朝百科全书式学者，著述涉及历史、地理、文学等，代表作《抚边杂录》。

people.name: Lê Hữu Trác (Hải Thượng Lãn Ông)
people.known_for: Physician who wrote the great compendium of Vietnamese traditional medicine.
people.known_for_zh: 越南传统医学大家，著有医学巨著《海上懒翁医宗心领》。

works.title: Hải Thượng y tông tâm lĩnh

people.name: Nguyễn Huệ (Quang Trung)
people.known_for: Tây Sơn leader who crushed a Siamese army in 1785 and a Qing army at Đống Đa in 1789.
people.known_for_zh: 西山朝统帅，1785年大破暹罗军，1789年在栋多击败清军，即位为光中帝。

people.name: Taksin
people.known_for: General of Chinese descent who drove out the Burmese after 1767 and reunited Siam.
people.known_for_zh: 华裔将领，1767年后驱逐缅军、重新统一暹罗，建立吞武里王朝。

people.name: Pigneau de Behaine
people.known_for: French bishop who raised help for Nguyễn Ánh in his war against the Tây Sơn.
people.known_for_zh: 法国主教，为阮福映争取法国援助，帮助其打败西山朝。

people.name: Nguyễn Du
people.known_for: Poet of The Tale of Kiều, the masterpiece of Vietnamese literature.
people.known_for_zh: 越南最伟大的诗人，代表作喃字长诗《金云翘传》是越南文学的巅峰。

people.name: Hồ Xuân Hương
people.known_for: Poet whose witty, daring Nôm verse mocked hypocrisy and the place of women.
people.known_for_zh: 越南女诗人，以大胆诙谐的喃字诗讽刺虚伪与男尊女卑，被称为“喃字诗女王”。

people.name: Stamford Raffles
people.known_for: British official who governed Java from 1811 to 1816 and founded modern Singapore in 1819.
people.known_for_zh: 英国殖民官员，1811至1816年治理爪哇，1819年建立现代新加坡。

Rattanakosin Kingdom.name: Mongkut
Rattanakosin Kingdom.note: Opened Siam to the West by treaty in 1855.
Rattanakosin Kingdom.note_zh: 1855年与英国签订条约，打开国门。

Rattanakosin Kingdom.name: Chulalongkorn
Rattanakosin Kingdom.note: Modernised Siam and kept it independent.
Rattanakosin Kingdom.note_zh: 推行现代化改革，保住暹罗独立。

Rattanakosin Kingdom.name: Prajadhipok
Rattanakosin Kingdom.note: Became a constitutional monarch after the revolution of 1932.
Rattanakosin Kingdom.note_zh: 1932年革命后成为君主立宪制国王。

Nguyễn dynasty.name: Nguyễn Phúc Hồng Nhậm
Nguyễn dynasty.note: France took the south as Cochinchina in 1862 to 1867.

Nguyễn dynasty.name: Nguyễn Phúc Minh
Nguyễn dynasty.note: Fled the capital and called the Cần Vương resistance.
Nguyễn dynasty.note_zh: 出奔京城，号召“勤王运动”抗法。

Konbaung dynasty.name: Bagyidaw
Konbaung dynasty.note: Lost Assam and Arakan in the First Anglo-Burmese War.
Konbaung dynasty.note_zh: 第一次英缅战争中失去阿萨姆和若开。

Konbaung dynasty.name: Mindon Min
Konbaung dynasty.note: Founded Mandalay and tried to modernise.
Konbaung dynasty.note_zh: 建立曼德勒城，推行改革。

people.name: Diponegoro
people.known_for: Javanese prince who led the Java War against Dutch rule from 1825 to 1830.
people.known_for_zh: 爪哇王子，1825至1830年领导反抗荷兰殖民统治的爪哇战争。

people.name: Tuanku Imam Bonjol
people.known_for: Leader of the Padri movement in West Sumatra who fought the Dutch until 1837.
people.known_for_zh: 西苏门答腊帕德里运动领袖，抗击荷兰殖民军直至1837年被俘。

people.name: Sunthorn Phu
people.known_for: Thailand's best loved poet, author of the long verse romance Phra Aphai Mani.
people.known_for_zh: 泰国最受爱戴的诗人，代表作长篇叙事诗《帕阿派玛尼》。

people.name: Francisco Balagtas
people.name_zh: 弗朗西斯科·巴拉格塔斯
people.known_for: Tagalog poet whose Florante at Laura is a classic of Philippine literature.
people.known_for_zh: 他加禄语诗人，代表作《弗洛兰第与劳拉》是菲律宾文学经典。

people.name: Raden Saleh
people.known_for: Javanese painter trained in Europe, the pioneer of modern Indonesian art.
people.known_for_zh: 爪哇画家，曾在欧洲学画，是印度尼西亚现代美术的先驱。

people.name: Nguyễn Đình Chiểu
people.known_for: Blind poet of the south who wrote Lục Vân Tiên and verse against the French conquest.
people.known_for_zh: 南部盲诗人，著有长诗《蓼云仙》，并写诗文号召抗击法国侵略。

people.name: Trương Định
people.known_for: Led guerrilla resistance to the French in Cochinchina after the court gave up the south.
people.known_for_zh: 在朝廷割让南圻后继续领导义军抗法，1864年战死。

people.name: Phan Đình Phùng
people.known_for: Mandarin who led the longest Cần Vương rising against the French until his death.
people.known_for_zh: 阮朝官员，领导规模最大、坚持最久的勤王抗法起义直至去世。

people.name: Petrus Trương Vĩnh Ký
people.known_for: Linguist who published the first newspaper in the Vietnamese Latin script.
people.known_for_zh: 语言学家，通晓多种语言，创办第一份国语字报纸《嘉定报》。

people.name: Alfred Russel Wallace
people.name_zh: 阿尔弗雷德·拉塞尔·华莱士
people.known_for: Naturalist who, working in the Malay Archipelago, arrived at natural selection independently of Darwin.
people.known_for_zh: 英国博物学家，在马来群岛考察期间独立提出自然选择学说，划出“华莱士线”。

people.name: Henri Mouhot
people.known_for: French naturalist whose travel notes made Angkor famous in Europe.
people.known_for_zh: 法国博物学家，其游记使吴哥古迹在欧洲广为人知。

works.title: Travels in the Central Parts of Indo-China
works.title_zh: 暹罗柬埔寨老挝诸王国旅行记

people.name: Multatuli
people.known_for: Dutch official whose novel Max Havelaar exposed abuses of colonial rule in Java.
people.known_for_zh: 荷兰殖民官员、作家，小说《马格斯·哈弗拉尔》揭露荷兰在爪哇殖民统治的罪恶。

people.name: José Rizal
people.known_for: Novelist and reformer whose execution by Spain in 1896 made him the national hero of the Philippines.
people.known_for_zh: 菲律宾作家、改革家，小说揭露西班牙殖民统治，1896年被处决，成为菲律宾国父。

people.name: Andrés Bonifacio
people.known_for: Founder of the Katipunan, which began the Philippine Revolution against Spain in 1896.
people.known_for_zh: 卡蒂普南秘密会社创建人，1896年发动反抗西班牙的菲律宾革命。

people.name: Apolinario Mabini
people.known_for: Lawyer and theorist of the Philippine Revolution, called the Brains of the Revolution.
people.known_for_zh: 律师、革命理论家，起草第一共和国的政纲，被称为“革命的头脑”。

people.name: Juan Luna
people.known_for: Painter whose Spoliarium won a gold medal in Madrid in 1884 and inspired Filipino nationalists.
people.known_for_zh: 菲律宾画家，巨作《屠场》1884年获马德里美展金奖，激励了民族主义者。

people.name: Prince Damrong Rajanubhab
people.known_for: Prince who reformed provincial government under Chulalongkorn and founded modern Thai history writing.
people.known_for_zh: 暹罗亲王，主持朱拉隆功时期地方行政改革，被称为泰国现代史学之父。

people.name: Phan Bội Châu
people.known_for: Nationalist who sent young Vietnamese to study in Japan and called for armed struggle against France.
people.known_for_zh: 越南民族主义者，发起“东游运动”派青年赴日留学，主张武装反法。

works.title: History of the Loss of Vietnam

people.name: Phan Châu Trinh
people.known_for: Reformer who argued for modern education and democracy as the road to independence.
people.known_for_zh: 越南维新派思想家，主张通过兴民智、开民权的改良道路争取独立。

people.name: Alexandre Yersin
people.known_for: Swiss French doctor who found the plague bacillus and spent his life in Nha Trang.
people.known_for_zh: 瑞士裔法国医生，发现鼠疫杆菌，后半生定居越南芽庄，创办巴斯德研究所分所。

people.name: Kartini
people.known_for: Javanese noblewoman whose letters on women's education made her a national hero of Indonesia.
people.known_for_zh: 爪哇贵族女性，其书信倡导女子教育和妇女解放，被尊为印度尼西亚民族英雄。

people.name: Ahmad Dahlan
people.known_for: Founder of Muhammadiyah, the modernist Islamic movement that built schools and hospitals.
people.known_for_zh: 1912年创立伊斯兰改革组织穆罕默迪亚，兴办大量学校和医院。

people.name: Hasyim Asy'ari
people.known_for: Islamic scholar who founded Nahdlatul Ulama in 1926, the largest Muslim organisation in Indonesia.
people.known_for_zh: 伊斯兰学者，1926年创立伊斯兰教士联合会，后成为印尼最大的穆斯林组织。

people.name: Tjokroaminoto
people.known_for: Leader of Sarekat Islam, the first mass political movement in the Dutch East Indies.
people.known_for_zh: 伊斯兰联盟领袖，领导荷属东印度第一个群众性政治运动，是苏加诺的老师。

people.name: Pridi Banomyong
people.known_for: Leader of the 1932 revolution that ended absolute monarchy in Siam, later prime minister.
people.known_for_zh: 1932年暹罗立宪革命的领导人之一，后任总理，并在二战中领导“自由泰”运动。

Indonesia.name: Suharto
Indonesia.note: Took power after the killings of 1965 and 1966.

South Vietnam.name: Nguyễn Văn Thiệu
South Vietnam.note: Head of state from 1965, elected president in 1967.
South Vietnam.note_zh: 1965年起任国家元首，1967年当选总统。

Thailand.name: Bhumibol Adulyadej
Thailand.note: Real power lay largely with military prime ministers such as Phibun, Sarit and Thanom.
Thailand.note_zh: 实权多在銮披汶、沙立、他侬等军人总理手中。

people.name: Hồ Chí Minh
people.known_for: Founder of the Indochinese Communist Party who declared Vietnam's independence in 1945.
people.known_for_zh: 越南共产党创始人，1945年宣布越南独立，领导抗法和抗美战争。

people.name: Võ Nguyên Giáp
people.known_for: Commander who defeated France at Điện Biên Phủ in 1954 and led the army against the United States.
people.known_for_zh: 越南人民军统帅，1954年指挥奠边府战役击败法军，后领导抗美战争。

people.name: Phạm Văn Đồng
people.known_for: Prime minister of North Vietnam and then of unified Vietnam for over thirty years.
people.known_for_zh: 越南民主共和国和统一后越南的总理，任职三十余年，曾率团参加日内瓦会议。

people.name: Lê Duẩn
people.known_for: Party leader who directed the war for the south and led Vietnam until 1986.
people.known_for_zh: 越南劳动党第一书记，主导统一南方的战争，掌权至1986年。

people.name: Lê Đức Thọ
people.known_for: Negotiator of the Paris Peace Accords of 1973, who declined the Nobel Peace Prize.
people.known_for_zh: 越南谈判代表，1973年与基辛格达成《巴黎和平协约》，拒绝接受诺贝尔和平奖。

people.name: Thích Quảng Đức
people.known_for: Buddhist monk who burned himself to death in Saigon in 1963 to protest persecution by the Diệm government.
people.known_for_zh: 越南僧人，1963年在西贡街头自焚，抗议吴庭艳政府迫害佛教徒。

people.name: Trịnh Công Sơn
people.known_for: Songwriter whose anti war ballads made him the voice of a generation.
people.known_for_zh: 越南作曲家、歌手，创作大量反战歌曲，被称为“越南的鲍勃·迪伦”。

people.name: Sukarno
people.known_for: Leader of the independence struggle and first president of Indonesia, host of the Bandung Conference.
people.known_for_zh: 印度尼西亚独立运动领袖和首任总统，提出“建国五基”，主持1955年万隆会议。

people.name: Mohammad Hatta
people.known_for: Co-proclaimer of Indonesian independence and its first vice president.
people.known_for_zh: 与苏加诺共同宣布印度尼西亚独立，任首任副总统，被称为“合作社之父”。

people.name: Tan Malaka
people.known_for: Marxist thinker and revolutionary who first set out the idea of an Indonesian republic.
people.known_for_zh: 印尼马克思主义思想家和革命家，最早提出建立印度尼西亚共和国的构想。

people.name: Chairil Anwar
people.known_for: Poet who led the Generation of 45 and modernised Indonesian verse.
people.known_for_zh: 印尼“四五年派”诗人的代表，开创现代印尼语诗歌，名作《我》。

people.name: Aung San
people.known_for: Leader who won Burma's independence from Britain but was assassinated months before it came.
people.known_for_zh: 缅甸独立运动领袖，被尊为“缅甸国父”，1947年独立前夕遇刺身亡。

people.name: U Nu
people.known_for: First prime minister of independent Burma, one of the founders of the Non-Aligned Movement.
people.known_for_zh: 独立后缅甸首任总理，不结盟运动的发起人之一，1962年被军事政变推翻。

people.name: Ne Win
people.known_for: General who seized power in 1962 and ruled Burma under the Burmese Way to Socialism.
people.known_for_zh: 缅甸将军，1962年发动政变上台，推行“缅甸式社会主义”，统治至1988年。

people.name: Tunku Abdul Rahman
people.known_for: First prime minister of Malaya and Malaysia, called the Father of Independence.
people.known_for_zh: 马来亚和马来西亚首任总理，1957年宣布马来亚独立，被尊为“国父”。

people.name: P. Ramlee
people.known_for: Actor, director and singer who was the great star of Malay cinema in the 1950s and 1960s.
people.known_for_zh: 马来电影演员、导演和歌手，是二十世纪五六十年代马来电影的代表人物。

people.name: Lee Kuan Yew
people.known_for: First prime minister of Singapore, who led it from 1959 to 1990 and made it a rich trading city.
people.known_for_zh: 新加坡首任总理，1959年至1990年执政，使新加坡发展为富裕的国际贸易中心。

people.name: Ramon Magsaysay
people.known_for: Popular president of the Philippines who defeated the Huk rebellion and died in a plane crash.
people.known_for_zh: 菲律宾总统，平定胡克军叛乱，深受民众爱戴，1957年死于空难。

people.name: Nick Joaquin
people.known_for: Leading Filipino writer in English, author of The Woman Who Had Two Navels.
people.known_for_zh: 菲律宾最重要的英语作家之一，代表作《有两个肚脐的女人》。

works.title: The Woman Who Had Two Navels

people.name: Norodom Sihanouk
people.known_for: King and leader of Cambodia who won independence from France in 1953.
people.known_for_zh: 柬埔寨国王和政治领袖，1953年使柬埔寨脱离法国独立，长期与中国友好。

people.name: Souphanouvong
people.known_for: The Red Prince who led the Pathet Lao and became the first president of Laos in 1975.
people.known_for_zh: 被称为“红色亲王”，领导巴特寮，1975年任老挝人民民主共和国首任主席。

people.name: Plaek Phibunsongkhram
people.known_for: Military prime minister who renamed Siam as Thailand in 1939 and led it for most of 1938 to 1957.
people.known_for_zh: 泰国军人总理，1939年将国名由暹罗改为泰国，1938至1957年间大部分时间执政。

people.name: Kukrit Pramoj
people.known_for: Writer of the novel Four Reigns and prime minister of Thailand in 1975 and 1976.
people.known_for_zh: 泰国作家、政治家，代表作长篇小说《四朝代》，1975至1976年任总理。

Indonesia.name: Suharto
Indonesia.note: Fell from power in 1998 amid the Asian financial crisis.

Indonesia.name: Megawati Sukarnoputri
Indonesia.name_zh: 梅加瓦蒂·苏加诺普特丽

Philippines.name: Ferdinand Marcos
Philippines.note: Overthrown by the People Power Revolution.

Philippines.name: Gloria Macapagal Arroyo
Philippines.name_zh: 格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔·阿罗约

people.name: Pol Pot
people.known_for: Leader of the Khmer Rouge, whose rule from 1975 to 1979 killed about a quarter of Cambodia's people.
people.known_for_zh: 红色高棉领导人，1975至1979年统治柬埔寨期间约四分之一的人口死亡。

people.name: Võ Văn Kiệt
people.known_for: Reformist prime minister who drove Vietnam's market opening in the 1990s.
people.known_for_zh: 越南改革派总理，二十世纪九十年代大力推动市场化改革和对外开放。

people.name: Goh Keng Swee
people.known_for: Deputy prime minister who planned Singapore's industrial growth and built its armed forces.
people.known_for_zh: 新加坡副总理，规划了新加坡的工业化和经济发展，并创建新加坡武装部队。

people.name: Benigno Aquino Jr.
people.known_for: Opposition leader whose murder on his return in 1983 turned Filipinos against Marcos.
people.known_for_zh: 菲律宾反对派领袖，1983年回国时在机场遇刺，激起民众反对马科斯独裁。

people.name: Corazon Aquino
people.known_for: Widow of Ninoy Aquino who led the People Power Revolution of 1986 and became president.
people.known_for_zh: 阿基诺遗孀，领导1986年“人民力量革命”推翻马科斯，成为菲律宾首位女总统。

people.name: Jaime Sin
people.known_for: Cardinal archbishop of Manila who called people into the streets in 1986.
people.known_for_zh: 马尼拉大主教、枢机，1986年号召民众走上街头，推动“人民力量革命”。

people.name: Lino Brocka
people.known_for: Film director whose films on Manila's poor brought Philippine cinema to world attention.
people.known_for_zh: 菲律宾电影导演，以描写马尼拉底层民众的影片使菲律宾电影闻名世界。

works.title: Manila in the Claws of Light

people.name: F. Sionil José
people.known_for: Novelist of the Rosales saga, a history of the Philippines told through one family.
people.known_for_zh: 菲律宾英语作家，代表作“罗萨莱斯五部曲”通过家族故事讲述菲律宾历史。

people.name: Pramoedya Ananta Toer
people.name_zh: 普拉姆迪亚·阿南达·杜尔
people.known_for: Novelist who composed the Buru Quartet while a political prisoner.
people.known_for_zh: 印尼最著名的作家，在布鲁岛政治犯营中构思写成“布鲁四部曲”。

people.name: W. S. Rendra
people.known_for: Poet and playwright whose protest works challenged the Suharto regime.
people.known_for_zh: 印尼诗人、剧作家，以抗议诗作和戏剧批评苏哈托政权，被称为“孔雀诗人”。

people.name: B. J. Habibie
people.known_for: Aircraft engineer who built Indonesia's aircraft industry and, as president, began its democratic transition.
people.known_for_zh: 飞机工程师，创建印尼航空工业，任总统期间开启民主转型。

people.name: Abdurrahman Wahid
people.known_for: Leader of Nahdlatul Ulama and champion of tolerant Islam, president from 1999 to 2001.
people.known_for_zh: 伊斯兰教士联合会领袖，倡导宽容的伊斯兰教，1999至2001年任印尼总统。

people.name: Ali Alatas
people.known_for: Indonesian foreign minister who helped broker peace in Cambodia.
people.known_for_zh: 印度尼西亚外交部长，在调停柬埔寨问题中发挥重要作用。

people.name: Prem Tinsulanonda
people.known_for: Prime minister of Thailand in the 1980s and long the king's chief adviser.
people.known_for_zh: 二十世纪八十年代泰国总理，后长期担任枢密院主席。

people.name: Ungku Abdul Aziz
people.known_for: Economist who fought rural poverty and set up the Malaysian pilgrims fund.
people.known_for_zh: 马来西亚经济学家，致力于消除农村贫困，倡议设立朝圣基金局。
